### Cloud connectivity for the AI era

Interconnect solutions designed to handle AI-driven traffic with performance, efficiency and
security

[Learn more ][145]

## Product focus

LiteWave800™ redefines what’s possible for intra-data center connectivity. Operating at just
1pJ/bit, it sets an industry benchmark – creating an entirely new power class for 800G optics. This
linear pluggable optics module will prove critical as data center operators face increasingly
stringent power, cooling, space and latency constraints.

### [ О компании ][172]


БАЗИС ТЕЛЕКОМ ー ведущий российский поставщик оборудования, комплектующих и решений для
телекоммуникационной отрасли.


Мы помогаем обеспечить скорость работы, масштабируемость и бесперебойность телекоммуникационных
сетей, предлагая бизнесу, государственным учреждениям и частным клиентам высококачественный сервис и
техническую поддержку на всех этапах работы. Мы обеспечиваем прямые поставки от
завода-производителя, подбирая уникальное оборудование и компоненты ー с меньшей ценой и большим
функционалом.




Мы всегда строим долгосрочные и взаимовыгодные отношения, где интересы заказчика ставятся на первое
место. БАЗИС ТЕЛЕКОМ берет на себя все риски на этапах закупки, доставки, предпродажного и
постпродажного обслуживания телекоммуникационного оборудования.

### [ О компании ][172]


БАЗИС ТЕЛЕКОМ ー ведущий российский поставщик оборудования, комплектующих и решений для
телекоммуникационной отрасли.


Мы помогаем обеспечить скорость работы, масштабируемость и бесперебойность телекоммуникационных
сетей, предлагая бизнесу, государственным учреждениям и частным клиентам высококачественный сервис и
техническую поддержку на всех этапах работы. Мы обеспечиваем прямые поставки от
завода-производителя, подбирая уникальное оборудование и компоненты ー с меньшей ценой и большим
функционалом.




Мы всегда строим долгосрочные и взаимовыгодные отношения, где интересы заказчика ставятся на первое
место. БАЗИС ТЕЛЕКОМ берет на себя все риски на этапах закупки, доставки, предпродажного и
постпродажного обслуживания телекоммуникационного оборудования.

Professional manufacturer of optical passive components: We provide our clients with a complete and

PM components including PM isolator, PM circulator, PM combiner, PM coupler, PM faraday rotator, PM
fiber mirror, PM WDM, PM patchcord and so on. Wavelength ranging from 400nm to 2050nm.

# HIGH POWER COMPONENTS

DK Photonics' high power components rang from 780nm to 2050nm, handling power from 300mW to

We design and manufacture remote monitoring systems for critical infrastructure. Our equipment
watches over your network sites 24/7, alerting you to problems before they become outages.
Who uses your monitoring systems?
Telecommunications companies, power utilities, transportation authorities, county governments, and
healthcare facilities rely on our equipment.

We customize solutions without engineering fees. Our equipment is designed and supported by the same
engineers who answer your support calls.

Exctel is a forward-thinking engineering and project management company specializing in advanced
systems integration, with a strong focus on telecommunications solutions. Leveraging extensive
experience in the oil and petroleum sectors, Exctel delivers cutting-edge digitalization and
automation services that enhance operational efficiency and safety.

By transforming complex technical challenges into streamlined, future-ready systems, Exctel ensures
robust performance and reliability for mission-critical operations.

[unsplash-image]

Project Management.

At Exctel, our project management approach is rooted in industry best practices, ensuring timely and
budget-conscious delivery of complex systems.

Our certified project managers employ advanced tools and methodologies to oversee every phase - from
initial planning to final execution, maintaining rigorous quality standards and fostering
transparent communication with stakeholders. This meticulous oversight guarantees that each project
aligns with our clients' strategic objectives and operational requirements.

Engineering.

Leveraging extensive cross-industry experience, our engineers deliver practical, resilient solutions
tailored for hazardous and high-stress environments where conventional methods fall short.

We implement industry best practices to design, integrate, and manage state-of-the-art
telecommunications and automation systems, ensuring operational excellence, safety, and reliability;
even in the most challenging environments.

[unsplash-image]
[unsplash-image]

Innovation.

Exctel drives innovation, spearheading digital transformation with advanced technologies. Leveraging
our expertise and industry insights, we implement sustainable solutions that help clients seamlessly
transition from legacy systems to efficient future-ready operations.

By integrating cutting-edge practices, Exctel empowers clients to achieve environmentally conscious
and efficient operations, guiding the transition toward a sustainable future.

why IdeaTek is bringing gigabit fiber internet to the Midwest, so you can have the freedom to do

## Why Fiber?

Fiber-optic Internet uses light to transmit data through fiber optic cables, rather than electricity
like traditional copper cable internet, making it more secure and reliable.

##### Blazing Light Speed

Fiber-optic can deliver data up to 25x faster than traditional cable.

##### Reliable Bandwidth

Fiber internet speeds remain consistent, even during high traffic.

##### Unlimited Data

Fiber networks can transport infinite amounts of data.

##### Enhanced Security

Fiber uses a dedicated connection that goes directly to your home.

Founded in 1951 by Bill Moog with a bold vision to empower people and solve tough problems through
trust and innovation, our company grew from a small airplane hangar in East Aurora into a global
leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and
challenge, Moog has remained committed to innovation and culture. Today, we continue to shape the
way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

Founded in 1951 by Bill Moog with a bold vision to empower people and solve tough problems through
trust and innovation, our company grew from a small airplane hangar in East Aurora into a global
leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and
challenge, Moog has remained committed to innovation and culture. Today, we continue to shape the
way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

# NM Data Cabling Installation London

## Data Cabling Services

NM Data Cabling is a data cabling installer and technology solutions provider. Since our formation
in 2000, we have consistently expanded the solutions we offer in the technology sector. Starting
with a focus on data cabling installation projects in London, we have expanded to locations
throughout the UK. We are fully accredited and specialists in data cabling, electrical installations
and complete Audio Visual, CCTV and access control solutions. We have an enviable industry
reputation and we focus on speed and quality of response for surveys, quotations, planning and
installation of our solutions.

## Data Cabling Installation

Accredited Structured Cabling Installers for CAT 5e, CAT 6, CAT 6a, CAT 7, & Fibre Optic Solutions

NM Cabling offers expert design and installation services for structured cabling systems, including
CAT 5e, CAT 6, CAT 6a, CAT 7, and fibre optic data cabling. Our certified designers, accredited by
RCCD and CNIDP,  provide tailored advice and innovative solutions for your technology infrastructure
needs.

As a CHAS accredited company, we prioritise health and safety, ensuring compliance with industry
standards. Our specialist team of network installers is qualified to implement systems from a wide
range of top manufacturers, offering dependable and professional service for projects of all sizes.
NM Cabling deliver high-quality, future-proof cabling solutions backed by robust safety and quality
certifications.

## Nationwide Network Cabling

NM Cabling provides professional, reliable network cabling solutions across the UK. Whether you’re a
small to medium-sized enterprise (SME), larger organisation;  based in London or elsewhere in the
country, our experts deliver fast and efficient cabling and technology services tailored to your
needs.

We specialise in serving commercial, industrial, and office environments, ensuring seamless
connectivity and optimal performance. Explore our portfolio of recent clients and case studies to
discover why businesses nationwide trust us for our prompt, consistent, and high-quality service.

### Cabling Services

[Data Cabling]

##### Data Cabling

One-stop data cabling solution based on over 20 years’ experience across various structured cabling
installations and industry sectors. Starting with initial planning and design through to
implementation and testing.

[Read more][18]
[Fibre Optics]

##### Fibre Optics

Fibre optic cabling a faster, more secure and reliable way of transmitting data. We offer diverse
fibre optic cabling services from legacy OM1 through to newer OM5 and OS2

[Read more][19]
[Wi-Fi Cabling]

##### Wi-Fi Cabling

Data cabling for a modern Wi-Fi Installations. With new technology advances, with transmission
capabilities to deliver the better bandwidth and speeds between Wi-Fi systems and active hardware.

[Read more][20]
[Electrical]

##### Electrical

Electrical installation and service for lighting, power systems for servers, air conditioning, UPS
systems and back-up generators. Floor boxes, dado trunking, false ceiling drops and permanent wired
systems or plug-and-play underfloor busbar systems for easy moves and changes.

[Read more][21]
[CCTV and Access]

##### CCTV & Access

CCTV cabling and hardware installation for all aspects of security and access control systems,
including CCTV video surveillance, door access control and gate security. Whether in commercial or
domestic environments, security systems are vital to protect property and assets to create a sense
of comfort and safety.

[Read more][22]
[Audio Visual]

##### Audio-Visual

industry-leading and high-efficiency component production processes in the manufacturing of optical
fiber connectors and PLC splitters. Its proprietary independently developed automated or
semi-automated production and testing equipment fully ensures the stability and consistency of the
components.

## About Us

**10px**

**10px**

**10px**

**10px**

ORTE Photonics Co., Ltd. was established in August 2002, a company in the optical components
manufacturing industry, which is a key strategic emerging industry supported by the country. ORTE
specializes in high-reliability optical passive and active products, including fused fiber couplers,
CWDM/DWDM, Mux/Demux module, CCWDM, isolators, combiners, 980nm pumped lasers, 1310/1550nm DFB
lasers, TO can, MEMS attenuator, and tap PD. Products are mainly applied in optical communication,
fiber sensing, and broadcasting and television systems, such as amplifiers, gyroscopes, hydrophones,
lasers, optical transceiver modules, and other equipment.

ORTE has been honored with titles such as “High-Tech Enterprise,” “National Specialty and New Giant
Enterprise,” and “Provincial Manufacturing Single Champion Enterprise.” The company has also
obtained ISO 9001 International Quality Management System Certification and ISO 14001 Environmental
Management System Certification from TUV Rheinland. Since its inception, ORTE has remained committed
to the vision of “becoming a global leader in fiber optic products,” guided by the management
philosophy of “people-oriented, technology-driven, globally oriented, and sustainably developed,”
while upholding the product philosophy that “reliability comes from expertise—ORTE earns my trust.”
With its renowned proprietary brand “ORTE,” the company has grown into a major global hub for the
R&D and manufacturing of fused fiber optic components. Its product reliability meets the
requirements of the Bellcore GR-1221-CORE standard.

In August 2024, the branch company ORTE Photonics (Thailand) Co., Ltd. was successfully registered.
Located in Rojana Industrial Park, Ayutthaya Province, Thailand, it is a modern optical components
manufacturing facility invested and established by ORTE Photonics Co., Ltd. in Thailand, with an
annual production capacity of 340,000 optical components.

## About Us

**10px**

**10px**

**10px**

**10px**

ORTE Photonics Co., Ltd. was established in August 2002, a company in the optical components
manufacturing industry, which is a key strategic emerging industry supported by the country. ORTE
specializes in high-reliability optical passive and active products, including fused fiber couplers,
CWDM/DWDM, Mux/Demux module, CCWDM, isolators, combiners, 980nm pumped lasers, 1310/1550nm DFB
lasers, TO can, MEMS attenuator, and tap PD. Products are mainly applied in optical communication,
fiber sensing, and broadcasting and television systems, such as amplifiers, gyroscopes, hydrophones,
lasers, optical transceiver modules, and other equipment.

ORTE has been honored with titles such as “High-Tech Enterprise,” “National Specialty and New Giant
Enterprise,” and “Provincial Manufacturing Single Champion Enterprise.” The company has also
obtained ISO 9001 International Quality Management System Certification and ISO 14001 Environmental
Management System Certification from TUV Rheinland. Since its inception, ORTE has remained committed
to the vision of “becoming a global leader in fiber optic products,” guided by the management
philosophy of “people-oriented, technology-driven, globally oriented, and sustainably developed,”
while upholding the product philosophy that “reliability comes from expertise—ORTE earns my trust.”
With its renowned proprietary brand “ORTE,” the company has grown into a major global hub for the
R&D and manufacturing of fused fiber optic components. Its product reliability meets the
requirements of the Bellcore GR-1221-CORE standard.

In August 2024, the branch company ORTE Photonics (Thailand) Co., Ltd. was successfully registered.
Located in Rojana Industrial Park, Ayutthaya Province, Thailand, it is a modern optical components
manufacturing facility invested and established by ORTE Photonics Co., Ltd. in Thailand, with an
annual production capacity of 340,000 optical components.

# Reach Optics Technology Co.,Limited

Reach Optics Technology Co.,Limited is founded in 2010, which is a leading provider for optical
active and passive products in China. We design,develop,manufacture and distribute the optical
products to satisfy customer's need for optical communication in Ethernet,SDH/SONET,Video
monitor,FTTH,WDM Netowrk, Access Network, CATV Network, EPON System etc. Currently Reach Optics can
offer the complete product lines including active and passive products, such as SFP,SFP BI-DI,SFP
CWDM, SFP+, QSFP+,100G QSFP28,100G CFP,CFP2,CFP4 Transceivers, XFP, X2, XENPAK, Media Converters,

# Reach Optics Technology Co.,Limited

Reach Optics Technology Co.,Limited is founded in 2010, which is a leading provider for optical
active and passive products in China. We design,develop,manufacture and distribute the optical
products to satisfy customer's need for optical communication in Ethernet,SDH/SONET,Video
monitor,FTTH,WDM Netowrk, Access Network, CATV Network, EPON System etc. Currently Reach Optics can
offer the complete product lines including active and passive products, such as SFP,SFP BI-DI,SFP
CWDM, SFP+, QSFP+,100G QSFP28,100G CFP,CFP2,CFP4 Transceivers, XFP, X2, XENPAK, Media Converters,
WDM(FWDM, Fused WDM), AWG Module, CWDM Mux/Demux, DWDM Mux/Demux, CCWDM Mux/Demux, FBT Coupler,PLC
Splitter,Optical Circulators, Optical Switch and PM Products,like PM Circulator, PM Coupler,
Polarization Beam Splitter etc.

##### infrastructure services to telecom operators and internet service providers (ISP’s). STPL is

##### Mumbai continuously expanding its current reach at Mumbai Navi Mumbai & Thane. STPL Dark Fibre

##### speed needed to serve customers helping to unlock new business opportunities. STPL Dark Fibre
##### hands you the controls to your data network. You can configure STPL fibre the way you want, to
##### deliver the privacy and performance coupled with the ability to upgrade limitless capacity
##### which the new 5G era demands.

##### and longevity of investment.

##### We deploy IBS on behalf of the Mobile Service Providers, which aims to expand mobile network
##### coverage and capacity in hard-to-access areas, in hospitals, hotels, malls, metros and

##### being integrated with our outdoor poles or rooftop poles solutions resulting in better
##### coverage. This State-of-the-Art In-Building Solution (IBS) provides mobile operators with the
##### ability to extend and distribute their cellular signal in and around buildings in areas where
##### outdoor tower signals are inadequate or non-existent. By implementing our plug-and-play design
##### architecture for the Mobile Service Providers, we deliver solutions independent of
##### technologies, enabling us to work on behalf of all operators efficiently and effectively. As a
##### part of our 5G ready IBS design, we are ready to provide a seamless user experience to our
##### customers’ clients. IBS is installed in metro stations, tunnels, tunnelling infrastructure,
##### offices, malls, hospitals, airports, and countless other locations.

##### Small Cell Solution offers rooftop poles and street furniture to accommodate small cellular
##### base stations to improve network coverage in densely populated areas and increase the
##### network’s capacity.

##### In-Building Solution (IBS)

##### We deploy IBS on behalf of the Mobile Service Providers, which aims to expand mobile network
##### coverage and capacity in hard-to-access areas, in hospitals, hotels, malls, metros and
##### airports, where accessing mobile networks is challenging. The deployed IBS is also capable of
##### being integrated with our outdoor poles or rooftop poles solutions resulting in better
##### coverage. This State-of-the-Art In-Building Solution (IBS) provides mobile operators with the
##### ability to extend and distribute their cellular signal in and around buildings in areas where
##### outdoor tower signals are inadequate or non-existent. By implementing our plug-and-play design
##### architecture for the Mobile Service Providers, we deliver solutions independent of
##### technologies, enabling us to work on behalf of all operators efficiently and effectively. As a
##### part of our 5G ready IBS design, we are ready to provide a seamless user experience to our
##### customers’ clients. IBS is installed in metro stations, tunnels, tunnelling infrastructure,
##### offices, malls, hospitals, airports, and countless other locations.

##### Small Cell Solution (SC)

##### Small Cell Solution offers rooftop poles and street furniture to accommodate small cellular
##### base stations to improve network coverage in densely populated areas and increase the
##### network’s capacity.

## What Do We Measure In An Internet Speed Test?

### Download Speed

How fast information can transfer to you. It affects things like the duration it takes to download
large files or display pages with many images. Download speed is measured in megabits per second
(Mbps).

### Upload Speed

How fast information can transfer from you. It affects things like how long it takes to post images
to social media or send big files via email attachments. Upload speed is measured in megabits per
second (Mbps).

### Ping Speed

It is the reaction time of your internet connection - how fast you get a response after you have
sent a request. A fast ping means a more responsive connection. Ping is measured in milliseconds
(ms).

## Frequently Asked Questions

How to perform an Internet Speed Test?
1. Open a browser and type [speed.is][8] in the address bar.
2. Select a Host ISP or let it choose the optimal ISP automatically.
3. Press the ‘GO’ button to start the Internet Speed Test.
Why is the internet speed test result lower than expected?

There can be a number of factors on why the speed test result was lower than expected. To ensure you
get the best results follow the tips below:
1. Connect the router to your device using an Ethernet cable. Should you must use the wireless Wi-Fi
   network, move the router or modem close to your PC or Mobile in which you are testing.
2. Pause downloads or any background activities such as software updates, streaming music or videos.
   Ideally no other devices should be connected while performing the internet speed test.
3. Talk with your Internet Service Provider (ISP) and ensure that you are subscribed to the correct
   internet plan. If you are using an optical fiber connection, a technician should examine of any
   possible interference. 

What is a good internet speed?

A good download speed is at-least 100 Mbps, and a good upload speed is at-least 10 Mbps. A 100 Mbps
connection can stream Netflix or YouTube, attend video conferences, and play online games in
multiple devices at the same time.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────

and HD Video Teleconferencing.                                                │                     
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Online Multiplayer Gaming, File Downloading and Uploading, Streaming Ultra HD │10-25 Mbps           
4K Video.                                                                     │                     
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────

## About Speed.is

Speed.is Internet Speed Test checks how fast is your internet connection speed and bandwidth for
broadband WiFi and mobile networks.

Speed.is speed test is compatible on all broadband and mobile connections: ADSL, cable modem, fiber
optic, Wi-Fi, satellite, and cellular 2G / 3G / 4G (LTE) / 5G.

We use a globally distributed dedicated servers network to measure your internet performance
accurately. You can test your internet speed via any web browser on a device of your choice such as
Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.

## What Do We Measure In An Internet Speed Test?

### Download Speed

How fast information can transfer to you. It affects things like the duration it takes to download
large files or display pages with many images. Download speed is measured in megabits per second
(Mbps).

### Upload Speed

How fast information can transfer from you. It affects things like how long it takes to post images
to social media or send big files via email attachments. Upload speed is measured in megabits per
second (Mbps).

### Ping Speed

It is the reaction time of your internet connection - how fast you get a response after you have
sent a request. A fast ping means a more responsive connection. Ping is measured in milliseconds
(ms).

## Frequently Asked Questions

How to perform an Internet Speed Test?
1. Open a browser and type [speed.is][8] in the address bar.
2. Select a Host ISP or let it choose the optimal ISP automatically.
3. Press the ‘GO’ button to start the Internet Speed Test.
Why is the internet speed test result lower than expected?

There can be a number of factors on why the speed test result was lower than expected. To ensure you
get the best results follow the tips below:
1. Connect the router to your device using an Ethernet cable. Should you must use the wireless Wi-Fi
   network, move the router or modem close to your PC or Mobile in which you are testing.
2. Pause downloads or any background activities such as software updates, streaming music or videos.
   Ideally no other devices should be connected while performing the internet speed test.
3. Talk with your Internet Service Provider (ISP) and ensure that you are subscribed to the correct
   internet plan. If you are using an optical fiber connection, a technician should examine of any
   possible interference. 

What is a good internet speed?

A good download speed is at-least 100 Mbps, and a good upload speed is at-least 10 Mbps. A 100 Mbps
connection can stream Netflix or YouTube, attend video conferences, and play online games in
multiple devices at the same time.

# Right for You.

Tellabs is well positioned to grow a number of large and promising markets. Find a solution that is
right for you below.

#### Passive Optical Networking Solutions

Tellabs® Optical LAN (OLAN) is a simple, scalable, stable and secure fiber-based enterprise network
solution. It simplifies the design, build and operations of local area networks that continue to
grow more complex. Most importantly, Tellabs Optical LAN delivers ultimate security in conjunction
inherently more secure fiber cabling, centralized management that assures consistent policies and
procedures and fewer points of network access vulnerability.

[Learn More][39]

#### Broadband Network Modernization Solutions

Tellabs® Broadband helps service providers converge, collapse and connect their access networks in a
cost-effective manner that leverages existing approved equipment and infrastructure. Tellabs
Broadband solutions can converge legacy analog services onto systems that have full support and
options for fiber and Ethernet connectivity.

# A Solution that’s
# Right for You.

Tellabs is well positioned to grow a number of large and promising markets. Find a solution that is
right for you below.

#### Passive Optical Networking Solutions

Tellabs® Optical LAN (OLAN) is a simple, scalable, stable and secure fiber-based enterprise network
solution. It simplifies the design, build and operations of local area networks that continue to
grow more complex. Most importantly, Tellabs Optical LAN delivers ultimate security in conjunction
inherently more secure fiber cabling, centralized management that assures consistent policies and
procedures and fewer points of network access vulnerability.

[Learn More][39]

#### Broadband Network Modernization Solutions

Tellabs® Broadband helps service providers converge, collapse and connect their access networks in a
cost-effective manner that leverages existing approved equipment and infrastructure. Tellabs
Broadband solutions can converge legacy analog services onto systems that have full support and
options for fiber and Ethernet connectivity.

# Empowering Connection

The mission of Trindom Global is to help our customers identify, plan, and achieve their IT
objectives. We do this through the strategic art of consultation. With our team of experts, key
vendor partnerships, proprietary design-build model, and professional installation and integration
services, Trindom Global works tirelessly to provide the exact IT solution you are looking for.

[Contact Us][24]

## Expert Design-Build and Integration Services

Trindom Global

Trindom Global LLC is a certified minority and women-owned, small business enterprise, specializing
in the design-build, installation, and integration of proprietary systems and capital equipment. Our
teams are experienced, certified, and licensed professionals. We are a service-based company that
creates lasting relationships with our clients by seeking to understand the goals and constraints,
design-building the best solution, and contributing our best efforts to every project. Our service
portfolio includes Installation Services & Integration Services of RF and Networks, Structural
Cabling and Headed Buildout, Medical Equipment, and much more.

### [Medical Equipment Installations
### ][25]

Trindom Global takes pride in providing the most qualified technicians to install medical equipment
in any hospital environment. Learn more about how we can assist you with our design-build and
Project Management services for all of your ME installation projects!

Learn More

### [Structured Cabling & Headend Buildout
### ][26]

The headend of a business’ network, telecoms, and TV are an essential part of its backbone to be
able to truly conduct daily operations in an efficient and productive manner. Trindom Global will
provide a highly skilled team to plan, coordinate, and manage deployment during all phases of your
buildout.

Learn More

### [Government Projects
### ][27]

Government projects have a business culture and process all to their own. Trindom Global understands
and excels in this process to bring the best products, services, and solutions within the
operational norms of this very unique ecosystem. Learn more about how we tailor to each RFP to bring
our level of excellence to each government project.

Learn More

### [RF & Network
### Installation
### ][28]

Trindom Global ensures our ability to perform high quality, seamless and frictionless uninstructive
commercial/hospitality TV and/or network installations. Installation teams perform their work
quickly, quietly, and professionally to keep with our standards to be customer friendly.

Learn More

### [Multifamily High-Speed ISP Solutions
### ][29]

Trindom Global thrives at designing and constructing high-speed ISP solutions for Multi-Family
campuses. With over 25 years of industry-specific experience, Trintel brings expert-level consulting
to the table in order to customize the perfect ISP solution for your campus.

Learn More

### [Find Out How Trindom Can Help You
### ][30]

We have years of experience in a variety of different fields that allows us to offer unparalleled
technical expertise to our clients in a variety of industries. Our team would be happy to connect
and see if we can help your business too.

Contact Us

## Our Partners

## Let us show you how we can add value to your business today!

[Contact Us][31]

# Transforming Connectivity: Managed Network Solutions for the Modern World

UberData Networks harnesses the power of state-of-the-art, AI-enabled network infrastructure,
advanced wireless technologies, and next-generation fiber optical LAN—supported by comprehensive
managed services—to deliver enterprise-grade connectivity across diverse industries and
environments. From initial design through 24/7 monitoring and lifecycle management, we operate your
network as a seamless extension of your IT team.

[Schedule a Consultation][26]
[View Recent Projects][27]

## State Agencies

Reliable networks for state offices, campuses, and public facilities.
Designed for uptime, security, and citizen services.

[View Details][28][View All Industries][29]

## Hotel & Resort

UberData Networks enhances hotel and resort connectivity by offering cutting-edge network solutions
to ensure your guests have a seamless and personalized experience from check-in to check-out.

[View Solutions][30][View All Industries][31]
[luxury resort and hotel]

## Industrial & Warehousing

UberData Networks boosts efficiency and security in industrial and warehousing sectors with
cutting-edge IoT and Optical LAN fiber solutions.

[View Solutions][32][View All Industries][33]
[manufacturing with robotics]

## Higher Education

UberData Networks revolutionizes higher education with advanced network solutions, fostering engaged
learning and robust campus-wide connectivity.

[View Solutions][34][View All Industries][35]
[University Campus]

UberData Networks improves K-12 education with secure, high-performance network solutions, fostering
engaging and connected learning experiences

[View Details][36][View All Industries][37]

enhancing every event's digital experience

# PASSIVE OPTICAL NETWORK PERFORMANCE...
# DELIVERED IN THE REAL WORLD

PON NETWORK TESTING AND PLANNING

UTEL provides a comprehensive portfolio of products and services which support telecoms operators to
roll out and monitor increasingly sophisticated full fibre passive optical networks (PON networks).

We apply our talent for innovation to every aspect of planning, building, commissioning, testing and
monitoring fibre optic networks, from dark fibre backhaul to PON networks.

UTEL’s centralised fibre optic network testing system is specifically designed to enable ambitious
investors and operators to maximise PON revenue, by constantly monitoring network performance, from
build, through provisioning and then in service. Utilising our own Optical Time Domain Reflectometer
(OTDR), optical switches and Wavelength Division Multiplexing system (WDM), our fibre testing system
works 24/7, providing real-time performance information and precise GIS locations when problems
occur.

[Fibre Testing - centralised fibe optic network monitoring and testing in real time »][18]

UTEL’s comprehensive fibre optic planning software provides all the tools and functionality you need
to design and optimise your PON network from concept to build pack. This planning software can be
seamlessly integrated with UTEL’s centralised fibre testing system to provide full life-cycle
monitoring of your fibre optic network.

[Network Planning - Learn more about our fully integrated passive optical network planning »][19]


[Please contact us for more info »][20]

With 25 years of experience and a team of passionate, certified experts, we deliver innovative

## Our Verticals

Discover How Our Tailored Solutions Help Organizations Thrive Across Key Industries
Data Centers Critical Infrastructure Healthcare Government Higher Education Commercial
Data Centers

As AI rapidly evolves, your data center infrastructure needs a scalable partner you can trust.
Vision Technologies is your partner for data center projects, simplifying the complexities of
denser, AI-driven demands. Trusted by many of the world’s largest hyperscale organizations, our
expertise in cabling, security, and rapid deployment ensures your infrastructure scales efficiently
across locations, giving you peace of mind while optimizing costs.

Critical Infrastructure

The backbone of our economy, critical infrastructure demands unwavering reliability and smart
technology. Vision Technologies offers specialized expertise to transportation, manufacturing, and
energy sectors. Our design-build approach to IT solutions ensures your critical facilities remain
connected and secure, streamlining operations, saving resources, and ultimately supporting the
continuous, safe delivery of essential services.

Healthcare

Providing exceptional patient care relies on the right technology. Vision Technologies simplifies
complex healthcare IT projects, offering expertise in systems integration and project execution. Our
technology design-build approach ensures your facility stays connected and protected, improving
patient experiences and saving you time and costly change orders, so you can prioritize what matters
most.

Government

Modernizing government IT infrastructure demands reliability and proven expertise. Vision
Technologies is your trusted partner, offering over 25 years of experience with federal, state, and
local agencies. Leveraging our Integrated Technology Delivery (ITD®) design-build methodology,
alongside our CMMI-SVC/3 appraisal, GSA pricing, and Top-Secret Facility Clearance, we simplify
complex IT projects, ensuring seamless integration and successful deployments for critical
government operations.

Higher Education

Navigating endless campus technology needs while maximizing budgets can be challenging. Vision
Technologies provides an “easy button” for higher education IT projects, offering expertise in
systems integration and project execution. Our technology design-build approach ensures your entire
campus stays connected and protected, maximizing your budget and positively impacting the student
learning experience.

Commercial

In the fast-paced commercial world, reliable technology is paramount. Vision Technologies is your
trusted partner for streamlining complex IT projects. We deliver expert systems integration and
project execution with a design-build approach, ensuring your workplace facilities are highly
connected,protected, and collaborative with building solutions designed for smart spaces. This
allows your business to operate more efficiently, saving valuable time and resources.
